questions.solutionText: Answer: Option A Explanation In the water image, The top side of the object becomes the bottom The bottom side of the object becomes the top The left and right sides of the object remain unchanged
questions.solutionHtml:
Answer: Option A

In the water image,

  • The top side of the object becomes the bottom
